/-- The total operator of a projective submeasurement is itself a projector. -/
theorem ProjSubMeas.total_proj {α : Type*} {ι : Type*}
    [Fintype α] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (P : ProjSubMeas α ι) :
    P.total * P.total = P.total := by
  calc
    P.total * P.total = (∑ a : α, P.outcome a) * P.total := by rw [P.sum_eq_total]
    _ = ∑ a : α, P.outcome a * P.total := by rw [Matrix.sum_mul]
    _ = ∑ a : α, P.outcome a := by
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
          intro a _ha
          exact P.outcome_mul_total_eq_outcome a
    _ = P.total := P.sum_eq_total

/-- Distinct outcomes of a projective submeasurement are orthogonal. -/
theorem ProjSubMeas.outcome_orthogonal {α : Type*}
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype α] [Fintype ι]
    [DecidableEq ι]
    (P : ProjSubMeas α ι) (a b : α) (hab : a ≠ b) :
    P.outcome a * P.outcome b = 0 := by
  classical
  set Pa := P.outcome a
  set Pb := P.outcome b
  have hsum : Pa + Pb ≤ P.total := by
    calc
      Pa + Pb
        = ∑ i ∈ ({a, b} : Finset α), P.outcome i := by
            simp [Pa, Pb, hab]
      _ ≤ ∑ i : α, P.outcome i := by
            exact Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg
              (by simp)
              (fun i _ _ => P.outcome_pos i)
      _ = P.total := P.sum_eq_total
  have hPb_le : Pb ≤ 1 - Pa := by
    calc
      Pb = Pa + Pb - Pa := by abel
      _ ≤ P.total - Pa := by
          exact sub_le_sub_right hsum Pa
      _ ≤ 1 - Pa := by
          exact sub_le_sub_right P.total_le_one Pa
  have hPa_herm : Paᴴ = Pa := P.outcome_hermitian a
  have hPb_herm : Pbᴴ = Pb := P.outcome_hermitian b
  have hPa_star : IsStarProjection Pa :=
    isStarProjection_iff'.2 ⟨by simpa [Pa] using P.proj a, hPa_herm⟩
  have hPaPbPa_nonneg : 0 ≤ Pa * Pb * Pa :=
    IsSelfAdjoint.conjugate_nonneg (P.outcome_pos b) hPa_herm
  have hPa_idem : Pa * (1 - Pa) * Pa = 0 := by
    rw [hPa_star.mul_one_sub_self, zero_mul]
  have hPaPbPa_eq_zero : Pa * Pb * Pa = 0 := by
    apply le_antisymm
    · calc
        Pa * Pb * Pa ≤ Pa * (1 - Pa) * Pa :=
          IsSelfAdjoint.conjugate_le_conjugate hPb_le hPa_herm
        _ = 0 := hPa_idem
    · exact hPaPbPa_nonneg
  have hPbPa_eq_zero : Pb * Pa = 0 := by
    apply Matrix.conjTranspose_mul_self_eq_zero.mp
    calc
      (Pb * Pa)ᴴ * (Pb * Pa) = (Paᴴ * Pbᴴ) * (Pb * Pa) := by
        simp [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul]
      _ = Pa * (Pb * Pb) * Pa := by
        simp [hPa_herm, hPb_herm, mul_assoc]
      _ = Pa * Pb * Pa := by simp [Pb, P.proj b]
      _ = 0 := hPaPbPa_eq_zero
  calc
    Pa * Pb = (Pb * Pa)ᴴ := by
      simp [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, hPa_herm, hPb_herm]
    _ = 0 := by rw [hPbPa_eq_zero]; simp

/-- Projective measurement outcomes are Hermitian (inherited from Measurement.outcome_pos). -/
theorem ProjMeas.outcome_hermitian {α : Type*} {ι : Type*}
    [Fintype α] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (P : ProjMeas α ι) (a : α) :
    (P.outcome a)ᴴ = P.outcome a :=
  Measurement.outcome_hermitian P.toMeasurement a

/-- Distinct outcomes of a projective measurement are orthogonal. -/
theorem ProjMeas.outcome_orthogonal {α : Type*}
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype α] [Fintype ι]
    [DecidableEq ι]
    (P : ProjMeas α ι) (a b : α) (hab : a ≠ b) :
    P.outcome a * P.outcome b = 0 := by
  let P' : ProjSubMeas α ι :=
    { toSubMeas := P.toSubMeas
      proj := P.proj }
  simpa [P'] using P'.outcome_orthogonal a b hab

/-- Any two outcomes of a ProjMeas commute. -/
theorem ProjMeas.outcome_commute {α : Type*}
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype α] [Fintype ι]
    [DecidableEq ι]
    (P : ProjMeas α ι) (a b : α) :
    P.outcome a * P.outcome b =
      P.outcome b * P.outcome a := by
  classical
  by_cases hab : a = b
  · subst hab; rfl
  · rw [P.outcome_orthogonal a b hab,
        P.outcome_orthogonal b a (Ne.symm hab)]

+coordinates, independently of redundant zero-weight support entries. -/
+private theorem avgOver_prod_swap_of_weight_symm
+    {X : Type*} [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X]
+    (μ : Distribution (X × X))
+    (hμ : ∀ x y, μ.weight (x, y) = μ.weight (y, x))
+    (f : X × X → ℝ) :
+    avgOver μ (fun xy => f (xy.2, xy.1)) = avgOver μ f := by
+  unfold avgOver
+  calc
+    (∑ xy ∈ μ.support, μ.weight xy * f (xy.2, xy.1)) =
+        ∑ xy : X × X, μ.weight xy * f (xy.2, xy.1) := by
+          symm
+          exact Distribution.sum_univ_eq_sum_support μ _ fun xy hxy => by
+            rw [μ.outsideSupport xy hxy, zero_mul]

+          rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]

+sum and occupying the two exchanged tensor sectors with equal amplitude. -/
+private def symmetrizedStrategy {G : SymmetricGame}
+    (S : Strategy G.toGame) : SymmetricStrategy G where
+  ι := Sum S.ιA S.ιB
+  ψ := symmState S.ψ
+  ψ_norm := (symmState_norm S.ψ).trans S.ψ_norm
+  ψ_swap := symmState_swap S.ψ
+  M := fun x => blockMeasurement (S.A x) (S.B x)

+  constructor <;> intro x <;>
+    exact blockMeasurement_isProjective (S.A x) (S.B x) (hS.1 x) (hS.2 x)

     2	
     3	/-!
     4	# Preliminary completion lemmas
     5	
     6	Structural completion helpers that stay close to `completeAtOutcome` while
     7	keeping only the light projectivity dependencies from
     8	`SwitchSandwichPrep/Core.lean`.
     9	-/
    10	
    11	open scoped BigOperators MatrixOrder Matrix ComplexOrder
    12	
    13	namespace MIPStarRE.LDT.Preliminaries
    14	
    15	open MIPStarRE.LDT
    16	
    17	/-- Completing a projective submeasurement at a distinguished outcome preserves
    18	projectivity. The residual effect `1 - P.total` is a projection orthogonal to
    19	`P.outcome a0`, so the completed effect remains idempotent. -/
    20	noncomputable def completeAtOutcomeProj {Outcome : Type*}
    21	    {ι : Type*} [Fintype Outcome] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    22	    (P : ProjSubMeas Outcome ι) (a0 : Outcome) : ProjMeas Outcome ι := by
    23	  classical
    24	  refine
    25	    { toMeasurement := completeAtOutcome P.toSubMeas a0
    26	      proj := ?_ }
    27	  intro a
    28	  by_cases ha : a = a0
    29	  · subst a
    30	    let T : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op ι := P.total
    31	    let Pa : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op ι := P.outcome a0
    32	    let R : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op ι := 1 - T
    33	    have hTT : T * T = T := by
    34	      simpa [T] using projSubMeas_total_proj P
    35	    have hPaT : Pa * T = Pa := by
    36	      simpa [Pa, T] using projSubMeas_outcome_mul_total_eq_outcome P a0
    37	    have hPa_star : IsStarProjection Pa :=
    38	      isStarProjection_iff'.2 ⟨by simpa [Pa] using P.proj a0,
    39	        (Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mp (P.outcome_pos a0)).isHermitian.eq⟩
    40	    have hT_star : IsStarProjection T :=
    41	      isStarProjection_iff'.2 ⟨hTT,
    42	        (Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mp P.total_nonneg).isHermitian.eq⟩
    43	    have hR_star : IsStarProjection R := by
    44	      simpa [R] using hT_star.one_sub
    45	    have hPaR : Pa * R = 0 := by
    46	      calc
    47	        Pa * R = Pa * (1 - T) := by rfl
    48	        _ = Pa - Pa * T := by rw [mul_sub, mul_one]
    49	        _ = 0 := by simp [hPaT]
    50	    have hproj :
    51	        (P.outcome a0 + (1 - P.total)) * (P.outcome a0 + (1 - P.total)) =
    52	          P.outcome a0 + (1 - P.total) := by
    53	      simpa [Pa, R] using (hPa_star.add hR_star hPaR).isIdempotentElem.eq
    54	    simpa [completeAtOutcome] using hproj
    55	  · simpa [completeAtOutcome, ha] using P.proj a
    56	
    57	@[simp] theorem completeAtOutcomeProj_toMeasurement {Outcome : Type*}
    58	    {ι : Type*} [Fintype Outcome] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    59	    (P : ProjSubMeas Outcome ι) (a0 : Outcome) :
    60	    (completeAtOutcomeProj P a0).toMeasurement = completeAtOutcome P.toSubMeas a0 :=
    61	  rfl
    62	
    63	@[simp] theorem completeAtOutcomeProj_toSubMeas {Outcome : Type*}
    64	    {ι : Type*} [Fintype Outcome] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    65	    (P : ProjSubMeas Outcome ι) (a0 : Outcome) :
    66	    (completeAtOutcomeProj P a0).toSubMeas = (completeAtOutcome P.toSubMeas a0).toSubMeas :=
    67	  rfl
    68	
    69	end MIPStarRE.LDT.Preliminaries

     3	/-!
     4	# Section 5 — Naimark tensor-product assembly
     5	
     6	Questionwise one-measurement Naimark data, the two-sided trace identity, and
     7	the source-facing tensor-product Naimark theorem in the projective-submeasurement
     8	form supplied by the paper's helper lemma.
     9	-/
    10	
    11	open scoped BigOperators MatrixOrder Matrix ComplexOrder
    12	
    13	namespace MIPStarRE.LDT.MakingMeasurementsProjective
    14	
    15	open MIPStarRE.LDT
    16	
    17	universe u
    18	
    19	private theorem idxSubMeas_outcome_sum_le_one
    20	    {Question Outcome ι : Type*}
    21	    [Fintype Outcome] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    22	    (A : IdxSubMeas Question Outcome ι) (x : Question) :
    23	    ∑ a, (A x).outcome a ≤ 1 := by
    24	  simpa [(A x).sum_eq_total] using (A x).total_le_one
    25	
    26	/-! ### Questionwise Naimark dilation interface -/
    27	
    28	/-- The one-measurement Naimark dilation attached to a single question.
    29	
    30	Paper origin: this is the questionwise application of
    31	`references/ldt-paper/orthonormalization.tex:121-159`
    32	(`\label{lem:naimark-helper}`) used in the proof of
    33	`references/ldt-paper/orthonormalization.tex:36-80`
    34	(`\label{thm:naimark}`), specifically the tensor-product assembly at
    35	`references/ldt-paper/orthonormalization.tex:161-187`. -/
    36	noncomputable def questionwiseOneMeasNaimarkData
    37	    {Question Outcome ι : Type*}
    38	    [Fintype Outcome] [DecidableEq Outcome]
    39	    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    40	    (A : IdxSubMeas Question Outcome ι) (x : Question) :
    41	    OneMeasNaimarkData Outcome ι :=
    42	  Classical.choose <| oneMeasNaimark ({
    43	    effect := (A x).outcome
    44	    pos := (A x).outcome_pos
    45	    sum_le_one := idxSubMeas_outcome_sum_le_one A x
    46	  } : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Submeasurement Outcome ι)
    47	
    48	/-- The questionwise Naimark data is attached to the intended source
    49	submeasurement. -/
    50	theorem questionwiseOneMeasNaimarkData_source_effect
    51	    {Question Outcome ι : Type*}
    52	    [Fintype Outcome] [DecidableEq Outcome]
    53	    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    54	    (A : IdxSubMeas Question Outcome ι) (x : Question) :
    55	    (questionwiseOneMeasNaimarkData A x).source.effect = (A x).outcome := by
    56	  simpa [questionwiseOneMeasNaimarkData] using
    57	    congrArg MIPStarRE.Quantum.Submeasurement.effect <|
    58	      Classical.choose_spec <| oneMeasNaimark ({
    59	        effect := (A x).outcome
    60	        pos := (A x).outcome_pos
    61	        sum_le_one := idxSubMeas_outcome_sum_le_one A x
    62	      } : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Submeasurement Outcome ι)
    63	
    64	/-- Lean-only questionwise Naimark interface.
    65	
    66	This theorem proves `NaimarkStatement`, the restricted interface consisting of
    67	per-question local dilations and single-outcome marginal preservation.  It is
    68	not the full tensor-product preservation statement of `thm:naimark`. -/
    69	theorem questionwiseNaimark {QuestionA OutcomeA QuestionB OutcomeB : Type*}
    70	    {ι : Type*}
    71	    [Fintype QuestionA] [DecidableEq QuestionA]
    72	    [Fintype OutcomeA] [DecidableEq OutcomeA]
    73	    [Fintype QuestionB] [DecidableEq QuestionB]
    74	    [Fintype OutcomeB] [DecidableEq OutcomeB]
    75	    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    76	    (ψ : QuantumState ι)
    77	    (A : IdxSubMeas QuestionA OutcomeA ι)
    78	    (B : IdxSubMeas QuestionB OutcomeB ι) :
    79	    ∃ data : NaimarkData QuestionA OutcomeA QuestionB OutcomeB ι,
    80	      NaimarkStatement ψ A B data := by
    81	  classical
    82	  let leftData : (x : QuestionA) → OneMeasNaimarkData OutcomeA ι :=
    83	    questionwiseOneMeasNaimarkData A
    84	  let rightData : (y : QuestionB) → OneMeasNaimarkData OutcomeB ι :=
    85	    questionwiseOneMeasNaimarkData B
    86	  have hleft : ∀ x : QuestionA, (leftData x).source.effect = (A x).outcome := by
    87	    intro x
    88	    simpa [leftData] using questionwiseOneMeasNaimarkData_source_effect A x
    89	  have hright : ∀ y : QuestionB, (rightData y).source.effect = (B y).outcome := by
    90	    intro y
    91	    simpa [rightData] using questionwiseOneMeasNaimarkData_source_effect B y
    92	  refine ⟨{ left := leftData, right := rightData }, ?_⟩
    93	  refine ⟨hleft, hright, ?_, ?_⟩
    94	  · intro x ρ a
    95	    simpa [leftData, hleft x] using (leftData x).expectation_preservation ρ a
    96	  · intro y ρ b
    97	    simpa [rightData, hright y] using (rightData y).expectation_preservation ρ b
    98	
    99	/-! ### Full tensor-product Naimark interface -/
   100	
   101	/-- The single auxiliary Hilbert space used by the full Naimark assembly on one side.
   102	
   103	The one-measurement theorem produces projectors on `H × Option Outcome`.  Since
   104	all questions on one side have the same outcome type, the different question
   105	measurements may be represented on the same auxiliary space, with a different
   106	Naimark unitary for each question. -/
   107	def oneNaimarkAuxHilbertSpace (Outcome : Type u)
   108	    [Fintype Outcome] [DecidableEq Outcome] :
   109	    FiniteHilbertSpace.{u} where
   110	  carrier := Option Outcome
   111	  instFintype := inferInstance
   112	  instDecidableEq := inferInstance
   113	  instNonempty := ⟨none⟩
   114	
   115	/-- The distinguished auxiliary basis state `|⊥⟩` for the one-register Naimark
   116	assembly. -/
   117	noncomputable def oneNaimarkAuxPureState (Outcome : Type u)
   118	    [Fintype Outcome] [DecidableEq Outcome] :
   119	    PureState (oneNaimarkAuxHilbertSpace Outcome).carrier :=
   120	  PureState.basis (none : Option Outcome)
   121	
   122	/-- The normalized auxiliary density state `|⊥⟩⟨⊥|`. -/
   123	noncomputable def oneNaimarkAuxState (Outcome : Type u)
   124	    [Fintype Outcome] [DecidableEq Outcome] :
   125	    QuantumState (oneNaimarkAuxHilbertSpace Outcome).carrier :=
   126	  oneNaimarkAuxPureState Outcome
   127	
   128	/-- The one-register auxiliary state is normalized. -/
   129	theorem oneNaimarkAuxState_isNormalized (Outcome : Type u)
   130	    [Fintype Outcome] [DecidableEq Outcome] :
   131	    (oneNaimarkAuxState Outcome).IsNormalized := by
   132	  exact PureState.toQuantumState_isNormalized (oneNaimarkAuxPureState Outcome)
   133	
   134	/-- The one-measurement preservation identity identifies the `⊥,⊥`
   135	compression block of the dilated projector with the original effect. -/
   136	theorem OneMeasNaimarkData.compression_none_none
   137	    {Outcome : Type u} [Fintype Outcome] [DecidableEq Outcome]
   138	    {d : Type u} [Fintype d] [DecidableEq d]
   139	    (data : OneMeasNaimarkData Outcome d) (a : Outcome) (i j : d) :
   140	    data.liftedEffect (some a) (i, none) (j, none) =
   141	      data.source.effect a i j := by
   142	  classical
   143	  letI : Nonempty d := ⟨i⟩
   144	  have h := data.expectation_preservation (Matrix.single j i (1 : ℂ)) a
   145	  unfold oneMeasLiftedDensity MIPStarRE.Quantum.normalizedTrace at h
   146	  simp [Matrix.trace, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.kronecker, naimarkAuxProjector,
   147	    Matrix.single, Fintype.sum_prod_type] at h
   148	  have hd : (Fintype.card d : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
   149	    exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_ne_zero
   150	  have hOutcome : (Fintype.card (Option Outcome) : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
   151	    exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_ne_zero
   152	  field_simp [hd, hOutcome] at h
   153	  have hsum_if_pair_eq :
   154	      ∀ F : d → d → ℂ,
   155	        (∑ x : d, ∑ y : d, if j = x ∧ i = y then F y x else 0) = F i j := by
   156	    intro F
   157	    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single j]
   158	    · rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i]
   159	      · simp
   160	      · intro y _ hyi
   161	        simp [show i ≠ y by exact fun h => hyi h.symm]
   162	      · intro hi
   163	        simp at hi
   164	    · intro x _ hxj
   165	      simp [show j ≠ x by exact fun h => hxj h.symm]
   166	    · intro hj
   167	      simp at hj
   168	  rw [hsum_if_pair_eq (fun y x => data.source.effect a y x)] at h
   169	  rw [← Finset.mul_sum] at h
   170	  rw [hsum_if_pair_eq (fun y x => data.liftedEffect (some a) (y, none) (x, none))] at h
   171	  have hc : (↑(Fintype.card Outcome) + 1 : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
   172	    positivity
   173	  exact mul_left_cancel₀ hc (by
   174	    calc
   175	      (↑(Fintype.card Outcome) + 1 : ℂ) *
   176	          data.liftedEffect (some a) (i, none) (j, none) =
   177	        data.source.effect a i j * (↑(Fintype.card Outcome) + 1 : ℂ) := h.symm
   178	      _ = (↑(Fintype.card Outcome) + 1 : ℂ) * data.source.effect a i j := by ring)
   179	
   180	/-- The two-sided trace identity for the full tensor-product Naimark assembly.
   181	
   182	Paper origin: `references/ldt-paper/orthonormalization.tex:161-187`, where the
   183	one-measurement helper is applied on Alice's and Bob's sides and then tensored
   184	with the auxiliary state.  The one-measurement theorem already gives the local
   185	compression identity for every test operator.  The statement below isolates the
   186	standard four-register trace calculation which turns the two local compression
   187	identities into preservation of bipartite correlations. -/
   188	theorem OneMeasNaimarkData.twoSidedCorrelationPreservation
   189	    {OutcomeA OutcomeB : Type u}
   190	    [Fintype OutcomeA] [DecidableEq OutcomeA]
   191	    [Fintype OutcomeB] [DecidableEq OutcomeB]
   192	    (HA HB : FiniteHilbertSpace.{u})
   193	    (ψ : QuantumState (HA.carrier × HB.carrier))
   194	    (leftData : OneMeasNaimarkData OutcomeA HA.carrier)
   195	    (rightData : OneMeasNaimarkData OutcomeB HB.carrier)
   196	    (a : OutcomeA) (b : OutcomeB) :
   197	    ev ψ (opTensor (leftData.source.effect a) (rightData.source.effect b)) =
   198	      ev
   199	        (naimarkProductExtensionState HA HB
   200	          (oneNaimarkAuxHilbertSpace OutcomeA)
   201	          (oneNaimarkAuxHilbertSpace OutcomeB)
   202	          ψ
   203	          (QuantumState.tensor
   204	            (oneNaimarkAuxState OutcomeA)
   205	            (oneNaimarkAuxState OutcomeB)))
   206	        (opTensor
   207	          ((leftData.toProjSubMeas).outcome a)
   208	          ((rightData.toProjSubMeas).outcome b)) := by
   209	  classical
   210	  have hleft_comp :
   211	      ∀ i j : HA.carrier,
   212	        leftData.liftedEffect (some a) (i, none) (j, none) =
   213	          leftData.source.effect a i j :=
   214	    OneMeasNaimarkData.compression_none_none leftData a
   215	  have hright_comp :
   216	      ∀ i j : HB.carrier,
   217	        rightData.liftedEffect (some b) (i, none) (j, none) =
   218	          rightData.source.effect b i j :=
   219	    OneMeasNaimarkData.compression_none_none rightData b
   220	  unfold ev
   221	  congr 1
   222	  unfold MIPStarRE.Quantum.normalizedTrace
   223	  simp [naimarkProductExtensionState, naimarkProductExtensionDensity,
   224	    QuantumState.tensor, oneNaimarkAuxState, oneNaimarkAuxPureState,
   225	    PureState.density, pureDensity, PureState.basis, Matrix.mul_apply,
   226	    Matrix.trace, opTensor, Matrix.kronecker, Matrix.vecMulVec]
   227	  simp [Fintype.sum_prod_type, OneMeasNaimarkData.toProjSubMeas,
   228	    mul_assoc, mul_left_comm, mul_comm]
   229	  field_simp
   230	  let cA : ℂ := Fintype.card (oneNaimarkAuxHilbertSpace OutcomeA).carrier
   231	  let cB : ℂ := Fintype.card (oneNaimarkAuxHilbertSpace OutcomeB).carrier
   232	  let S : ℂ :=
   233	    ∑ x : HA.carrier,
   234	      ∑ x_1 : HB.carrier,
   235	        ∑ x_2 : HA.carrier,
   236	          ∑ x_3 : HB.carrier,
   237	            ψ.density (x, x_1) (x_2, x_3) *
   238	              leftData.source.effect a x_2 x *
   239	              rightData.source.effect b x_3 x_1
   240	  change S * cA * cB =
   241	    ∑ x : HA.carrier,
   242	      ∑ x_1 : HB.carrier,
   243	        ∑ x_2 : HA.carrier,
   244	          ∑ x_3 : HB.carrier,
   245	            cA * cB * ψ.density (x, x_1) (x_2, x_3) *
   246	              leftData.liftedEffect (some a) (x_2, none) (x, none) *
   247	              rightData.liftedEffect (some b) (x_3, none) (x_1, none)
   248	  rw [show
   249	      (∑ x : HA.carrier,
   250	        ∑ x_1 : HB.carrier,
   251	          ∑ x_2 : HA.carrier,
   252	            ∑ x_3 : HB.carrier,
   253	              cA * cB * ψ.density (x, x_1) (x_2, x_3) *
   254	                leftData.liftedEffect (some a) (x_2, none) (x, none) *
   255	                rightData.liftedEffect (some b) (x_3, none) (x_1, none)) =
   256	        cA * cB * S by
   257	      calc
   258	        (∑ x : HA.carrier,
   259	          ∑ x_1 : HB.carrier,
   260	            ∑ x_2 : HA.carrier,
   261	              ∑ x_3 : HB.carrier,
   262	                cA * cB * ψ.density (x, x_1) (x_2, x_3) *
   263	                  leftData.liftedEffect (some a) (x_2, none) (x, none) *
   264	                  rightData.liftedEffect (some b) (x_3, none) (x_1, none))
   265	            = ∑ x : HA.carrier,
   266	              ∑ x_1 : HB.carrier,
   267	                ∑ x_2 : HA.carrier,
   268	                  ∑ x_3 : HB.carrier,
   269	                    cA * cB *
   270	                      (ψ.density (x, x_1) (x_2, x_3) *
   271	                        leftData.source.effect a x_2 x *
   272	                        rightData.source.effect b x_3 x_1) := by
   273	              refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
   274	              intro x _
   275	              refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
   276	              intro x_1 _
   277	              refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
   278	              intro x_2 _
   279	              refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
   280	              intro x_3 _
   281	              rw [hleft_comp x_2 x, hright_comp x_3 x_1]
   282	              ring
   283	        _ = cA * cB * S := by
   284	              simp [S, mul_assoc, Finset.mul_sum]]
   285	  ring_nf
   286	
   287	/-- Full tensor-product Naimark correlation theorem.
   288	
   289	This is the Lean statement corresponding to
   290	`references/ldt-paper/orthonormalization.tex:36-80`
   291	(`\label{thm:naimark}`).  It is proved from the checked one-measurement
   292	Naimark construction and the two-sided trace identity
   293	`OneMeasNaimarkData.twoSidedCorrelationPreservation`. -/
   294	theorem naimarkTensorProductCorrelation
   295	    {QuestionA OutcomeA QuestionB OutcomeB : Type u}
   296	    [Fintype QuestionA] [DecidableEq QuestionA]
   297	    [Fintype OutcomeA] [DecidableEq OutcomeA]
   298	    [Fintype QuestionB] [DecidableEq QuestionB]
   299	    [Fintype OutcomeB] [DecidableEq OutcomeB]
   300	    (HA HB : FiniteHilbertSpace.{u})
   301	    (ψ : QuantumState (HA.carrier × HB.carrier))
   302	    (A : IdxSubMeas QuestionA OutcomeA HA.carrier)
   303	    (B : IdxSubMeas QuestionB OutcomeB HB.carrier) :
   304	    NaimarkTensorProductCorrelationStatement HA HB ψ A B := by
   305	  classical
   306	  intro hψ
   307	  let HauxA : FiniteHilbertSpace.{u} := oneNaimarkAuxHilbertSpace OutcomeA
   308	  let HauxB : FiniteHilbertSpace.{u} := oneNaimarkAuxHilbertSpace OutcomeB
   309	  let auxLeft : QuantumState HauxA.carrier := oneNaimarkAuxState OutcomeA
   310	  let auxRight : QuantumState HauxB.carrier := oneNaimarkAuxState OutcomeB
   311	  let auxState : QuantumState (HauxA.carrier × HauxB.carrier) :=
   312	    QuantumState.tensor auxLeft auxRight
   313	  let leftData : (x : QuestionA) → OneMeasNaimarkData OutcomeA HA.carrier :=
   314	    fun x => Classical.choose <| oneMeasNaimark ({
   315	      effect := (A x).outcome
   316	      pos := (A x).outcome_pos
   317	      sum_le_one := idxSubMeas_outcome_sum_le_one A x
   318	    } : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Submeasurement OutcomeA HA.carrier)
   319	  let rightData : (y : QuestionB) → OneMeasNaimarkData OutcomeB HB.carrier :=
   320	    fun y => Classical.choose <| oneMeasNaimark ({
   321	      effect := (B y).outcome
   322	      pos := (B y).outcome_pos
   323	      sum_le_one := idxSubMeas_outcome_sum_le_one B y
   324	    } : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Submeasurement OutcomeB HB.carrier)
   325	  have hleft : ∀ x : QuestionA, (leftData x).source.effect = (A x).outcome := by
   326	    intro x
   327	    simpa [leftData] using congrArg MIPStarRE.Quantum.Submeasurement.effect <|
   328	      Classical.choose_spec <| oneMeasNaimark ({
   329	        effect := (A x).outcome
   330	        pos := (A x).outcome_pos
   331	        sum_le_one := idxSubMeas_outcome_sum_le_one A x
   332	      } : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Submeasurement OutcomeA HA.carrier)
   333	  have hright : ∀ y : QuestionB, (rightData y).source.effect = (B y).outcome := by
   334	    intro y
   335	    simpa [rightData] using congrArg MIPStarRE.Quantum.Submeasurement.effect <|
   336	      Classical.choose_spec <| oneMeasNaimark ({
   337	        effect := (B y).outcome
   338	        pos := (B y).outcome_pos
   339	        sum_le_one := idxSubMeas_outcome_sum_le_one B y
   340	      } : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Submeasurement OutcomeB HB.carrier)
   341	  have hauxLeft : auxLeft.IsNormalized := by
   342	    simpa [auxLeft, HauxA] using oneNaimarkAuxState_isNormalized OutcomeA
   343	  have hauxRight : auxRight.IsNormalized := by
   344	    simpa [auxRight, HauxB] using oneNaimarkAuxState_isNormalized OutcomeB
   345	  have hauxState : auxState.IsNormalized := by
   346	    exact QuantumState.tensor_isNormalized hauxLeft hauxRight
   347	  refine ⟨HauxA, HauxB, ⟨?_⟩⟩
   348	  exact {
   349	    auxState := auxState
   350	    auxState_normalized := hauxState
   351	    auxLeft := auxLeft
   352	    auxRight := auxRight
   353	    auxLeft_normalized := hauxLeft
   354	    auxRight_normalized := hauxRight
   355	    auxState_product := rfl
   356	    dilatedState := naimarkProductExtensionState HA HB HauxA HauxB ψ auxState
   357	    dilatedState_density := rfl
   358	    dilatedState_normalized :=
   359	      naimarkProductExtensionState_isNormalized HA HB HauxA HauxB hψ hauxState
   360	    left := fun x => (leftData x).toProjSubMeas

     3	/-!
     4	# Finite-dimensional state transformations
     5	
     6	This file defines the tensor and reindexing operations used for strategy
     7	distance, Magic Square rigidity, and the qudit-to-qubit isomorphism. See
     8	blueprint chapters 11--13 and the declaration-level references below.
     9	-/
    10	
    11	open scoped Matrix
    12	
    13	namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
    14	
    15	open MIPStarRE.Quantum
    16	
    17	/-- Conjugation by the local isometries in `thm:ms-rigidity` and
    18	`lem:pauli-binary`; blueprint `ch13_qpbt_test.tex:222-244` and
    19	`ch11_qpbt_algebra.tex:710-741`, paper
    20	`08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:620-652` and
    21	`04_preliminaries.tex:1163-1208`. -/
    22	noncomputable def conjIsometry {ι ι' : Type*}
    23	    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι'] [DecidableEq ι']
    24	    (φ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ ι')
    25	    (M : Op ι) : Op ι' :=
    26	  let U : Matrix ι' ι ℂ := Matrix.toEuclideanLin.symm φ.toLinearMap
    27	  U * M * Uᴴ
    28	
    29	/-- Coordinate transport used by `def:strategy-distance`, blueprint
    30	`ch12_qpbt_games.tex:228-237`, paper `06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:273-285`. -/
    31	noncomputable def reindexState {ι ι' : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    32	    [Fintype ι'] [DecidableEq ι'] (e : ι ≃ ι')
    33	    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι' :=
    34	  (EuclideanSpace.equiv ι' ℂ).symm
    35	    (fun j => (EuclideanSpace.equiv ι ℂ ψ) (e.symm j))
    36	
    37	/-- Apply the two independent local isometries of `thm:ms-rigidity`; blueprint
    38	`ch13_qpbt_test.tex:222-244`, paper
    39	`08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:620-652`. -/
    40	noncomputable def isometryTensor
    41	    {ιA ιB κA κB : Type*}
    42	    [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA] [Fintype ιB] [DecidableEq ιB]
    43	    [Fintype κA] [DecidableEq κA] [Fintype κB] [DecidableEq κB]
    44	    (φA : EuclideanSpace ℂ ιA →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ κA)
    45	    (φB : EuclideanSpace ℂ ιB →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ κB)
    46	    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB)) :
    47	    EuclideanSpace ℂ (κA × κB) :=
    48	  (EuclideanSpace.equiv (κA × κB) ℂ).symm
    49	    (fun p =>
    50	      ∑ i : ιA, ∑ j : ιB,
    51	        ((EuclideanSpace.equiv κA ℂ)
    52	            (φA ((EuclideanSpace.equiv ιA ℂ).symm (Pi.single i 1))) p.1) *
    53	          ((EuclideanSpace.equiv κB ℂ)
    54	            (φB ((EuclideanSpace.equiv ιB ℂ).symm (Pi.single j 1))) p.2) *
    55	          ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (ιA × ιB) ℂ) ψ (i, j)))
    56	
    57	/-- Coordinate tensor used in the ideal state of `thm:ms-rigidity`; blueprint
    58	`ch13_qpbt_test.tex:222-244`, paper
    59	`08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:620-652`. -/
    60	noncomputable def vecTensor {ι κ : Type*}
    61	    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ]
    62	    (u : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) (v : EuclideanSpace ℂ κ) :
    63	    EuclideanSpace ℂ (ι × κ) :=
    64	  (EuclideanSpace.equiv (ι × κ) ℂ).symm
    65	    (fun p => (EuclideanSpace.equiv ι ℂ u) p.1 * (EuclideanSpace.equiv κ ℂ v) p.2)
    66	
    67	/-- Operator transport used by `def:strategy-distance`, blueprint
    68	`ch12_qpbt_games.tex:228-237`, paper `06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:273-285`. -/
    69	def reindexOp {ι ι' : Type*} (e : ι ≃ ι') (M : Op ι') : Op ι :=
    70	  (Matrix.reindex e.symm e.symm) M
    71	
    72	/-- Four-factor tensor shuffle used by `thm:ms-rigidity`; blueprint
    73	`ch13_qpbt_test.tex:222-244`, paper
    74	`08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:620-652`. -/
    75	def prodShuffle {α β γ δ : Type*} :
    76	    (α × β) × (γ × δ) ≃ (α × γ) × (β × δ) where
    77	  toFun p := ((p.1.1, p.2.1), (p.1.2, p.2.2))
    78	  invFun p := ((p.1.1, p.2.1), (p.1.2, p.2.2))
    79	  left_inv p := by cases p; rfl
    80	  right_inv p := by cases p; rfl
    81	
    82	end MIPStarRE.QPBT

    60	noncomputable def marginalLeft {α β d : Type*}

    76	/-- Projectivity of every effect in a POVM (`def:povm-conventions`, blueprint

    79	def Measurement.IsProjective {α d : Type*} [Fintype α] [Fintype d] [DecidableEq d]

    83	/--
    84	The tensor-product strategy of `def:tensor-product-strategy` in

    86	`references/qpbt-paper/06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:26-38`).

    88	structure Strategy (G : Game) where
    89	  ιA : Type
    90	  ιB : Type
    91	  [ιAFintype : Fintype ιA]
    92	  [ιBFintype : Fintype ιB]
    93	  [ιADecidableEq : DecidableEq ιA]
    94	  [ιBDecidableEq : DecidableEq ιB]
    95	  ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB)
    96	  ψ_norm : ‖ψ‖ = 1
    97	  A : G.QuestionA → Measurement G.AnswerA ιA

   175	/--

   178	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch12_qpbt_games.tex:71-82`, with paper origin
   179	`references/qpbt-paper/06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:40-57`.

   181	noncomputable def Strategy.value {G : Game} (S : Strategy G) : ℝ :=
   182	  avgOver G.μ (fun xy =>
   183	    ∑ a : G.AnswerA, ∑ b : G.AnswerB,

   192	intentionally not asserted here.

   195	  sSup (Set.range (fun S : Strategy G => S.value))

   562	    (L : LdSpace P.toLdParams → LdSpace P.toLdParams) :
   563	    (fun z : PauliSpace P => embedLd P W (L (pauliToLd P W z))) =

   565	        (L (fun k => z (pauliLdIndex P W k))) := by
   566	  funext z

   579	  cases t with

   584	      rw [pauliCL_reindex P W (ldPointCL P.toLdParams)]

   606	/-- A finite edge set for the typed Pauli question graph.  The self-loops and
   607	the displayed type-incidence families are the graph used by the sampler in
   608	`def:pauli-question-distribution`, blueprint lines 285-329, paper origin
   609	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:964-1120`.
   610	-/
   611	def pauliEdges : Finset (Sym2 PauliType) :=
   612	  let loops := Finset.univ.image (fun t : PauliType => Sym2.mk t t)
   613	  let lineEdges :=
   614	    (Finset.univ : Finset PauliKind).image (fun W =>
   615	      Sym2.mk (.point W) (.aline W)) ∪
   616	      (Finset.univ : Finset PauliKind).image (fun W =>
   617	        Sym2.mk (.point W) (.dline W)) ∪
   618	      (Finset.univ : Finset PauliKind).image (fun W =>
   619	        Sym2.mk (.point W) (.pauli W))
   620	  let basisEdges :=
   621	    (Finset.univ : Finset PauliKind).image (fun W =>
   622	      Sym2.mk (.point W) (.pairW W)) ∪
   623	      ({Sym2.mk (.point .X) (.ms (.var ⟨0, by decide⟩)),
   624	        Sym2.mk (.point .Z) (.ms (.var ⟨4, by decide⟩))} : Finset (Sym2 PauliType))
   625	  let pairEdges :=
   626	    (Finset.univ : Finset PauliKind).image (fun W =>
   627	      Sym2.mk (.pairW W) .pair)
   628	  let msEdges' :=
   629	    (Finset.univ : Finset (MsType × MsType)).filter (fun xy =>
   630	      Sym2.mk xy.1 xy.2 ∈ msEdges) |>.image (fun xy =>
   631	        Sym2.mk (.ms xy.1) (.ms xy.2))
   632	  loops ∪ lineEdges ∪ basisEdges ∪ pairEdges ∪ msEdges'
   633

   647	/-- The ordered-edge subtype used by the Pauli question sampler.  This is

   656	/-- The Pauli graph has a loop, so its ordered-edge subtype is nonempty.  This

   661	theorem pauliEdge_nonempty : Nonempty PauliEdge := by
   662	  refine ⟨⟨(.point .X, .point .X), ?_⟩⟩

   665	/-- The Pauli question distribution from `def:pauli-question-distribution`,
   666	blueprint `ch13_qpbt_test.tex:285-329`, paper origin
   667	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1070-1120`.

   669	noncomputable def pauliQuestionDistribution (P : AdmissibleParams) :
   670	    Distribution (PauliQuestion P × PauliQuestion P) :=
   671	  by
   672	    classical
   673	    letI : Nonempty PauliEdge := pauliEdge_nonempty
   674	    exact
   675	      Distribution.map
   676	        (uniformDistribution (PauliEdge × PauliSpace P))
   677	        (fun s =>
   678	          ((s.1.1.1, pauliCL P s.1.1.1 s.2),
   679	            (s.1.1.2, pauliCL P s.1.1.2 s.2)))

   685	inductive PauliAnswer (P : AdmissibleParams) where
   686	  | value (a : PauliScalar P)
   687	  | alinePoly (a : Fin (P.d + 1) → PauliScalar P)
   688	  | dlinePoly (a : Fin (P.m * P.d + 1) → PauliScalar P)
   689	  | pairBits (a : ZMod 2 × ZMod 2)
   690	  | bit (a : ZMod 2)
   691	  | msTriple (a : Fin 3 → ZMod 2)
   692	  | pauliOutcome (a : PauliRegister P)

   695	/-- A formalization-only total relabeling from the global Pauli-test answer
   696	alphabet to a Pauli register. It folds wrong-form answers into zero so that a
   697	Pauli question yields a complete `PauliRegister`-indexed measurement. -/

   702	/-- A finite sum code used only to construct the `Fintype` instance for the
   703	answer alphabet in `def:pauli-win-predicate`, blueprint
   704	`ch13_qpbt_test.tex:331-367`, paper origin
   705	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1126-1225`.

   707	abbrev PauliAnswerCode (P : AdmissibleParams) :=
   708	  PauliScalar P ⊕
   709	    ((Fin (P.d + 1) → PauliScalar P) ⊕
   710	      ((Fin (P.m * P.d + 1) → PauliScalar P) ⊕
   711	        ((ZMod 2 × ZMod 2) ⊕
   712	          (ZMod 2 ⊕ ((Fin 3 → ZMod 2) ⊕ PauliRegister P)))))

   714	/-- The constructor-preserving finite-code equivalence for `PauliAnswer`.
   715	Lean-only infrastructure for `def:pauli-win-predicate`, blueprint
   716	`ch13_qpbt_test.tex:331-367`, paper origin
   717	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1126-1225`.

   719	noncomputable def pauliAnswerEquiv (P : AdmissibleParams) :
   720	    PauliAnswer P ≃ PauliAnswerCode P where
   721	  toFun
   722	    | .value a => .inl a
   723	    | .alinePoly a => .inr (.inl a)
   724	    | .dlinePoly a => .inr (.inr (.inl a))
   725	    | .pairBits a => .inr (.inr (.inr (.inl a)))
   726	    | .bit a => .inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inl a))))
   727	    | .msTriple a => .inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inl a)))))
   728	    | .pauliOutcome a => .inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inr a)))))
   729	  invFun
   730	    | .inl a => .value a
   731	    | .inr (.inl a) => .alinePoly a
   732	    | .inr (.inr (.inl a)) => .dlinePoly a
   733	    | .inr (.inr (.inr (.inl a))) => .pairBits a
   734	    | .inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inl a)))) => .bit a
   735	    | .inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inl a))))) => .msTriple a
   736	    | .inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inr a))))) => .pauliOutcome a
   737	  left_inv := by
   738	    intro x
   739	    cases x <;> rfl
   740	  right_inv := by
   741	    intro x
   742	    cases x with
   743	    | inl a => rfl
   744	    | inr x =>
   745	        cases x with
   746	        | inl a => rfl
   747	        | inr x =>
   748	            cases x with
   749	            | inl a => rfl
   750	            | inr x =>
   751	                cases x with
   752	                | inl a => rfl
   753	                | inr x =>
   754	                    cases x with
   755	                    | inl a => rfl
   756	                    | inr x =>
   757	                        cases x with
   758	                        | inl a => rfl
   759	                        | inr a => rfl

   796	  | .aline _, .alinePoly _ => true

   805	/-- The axis-line versus point relation used by `def:pauli-win-predicate`,

   809	def pauliAlinePointCondition (P : AdmissibleParams) (W : PauliKind)
   810	    (line point : PauliSpace P) (f : Fin (P.d + 1) → PauliScalar P)

   812	  -- The universal form preserves the source's zero-direction convention.
   813	  ∀ t : PauliScalar P,
   814	    pauliPointBlock W point =

   816	          (chiIndex P.toLdParams (pauliScalarBlock line)) →
   817	      evalCoefficient f t = a

   839	/-- The Pair/W consistency relation, including the one-sided gamma gate, from
   840	`def:pauli-win-predicate`, blueprint `ch13_qpbt_test.tex:331-367`, paper origin

   844	    (z : PauliSpace P) (β : ZMod 2) (bits : ZMod 2 × ZMod 2) : Prop :=

   846	    (match W with

   853	-/
   854	def pauliPointPairCondition (P : AdmissibleParams) (W : PauliKind)
   855	    (z : PauliSpace P) (a : PauliScalar P) (β : ZMod 2) : Prop :=
   856	  pauliPairGamma P z ≠ 0 ∨
   857	    fixedBinTrace P.model
   858	      (a * (match W with
   859	      | .X => pauliRXBlock z
   860	      | .Z => pauliRZBlock z)) = β
   861	
   862	/-- The Point/Variable consistency clause of `def:pauli-win-predicate`.
   863	The check is gated by `gamma = 0` and only uses Variable 1 in the X basis or
   864	Variable 5 in the Z basis.  Blueprint
   865	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:331-367`; paper origin
   866	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1126-1225`.
   867	-/
   868	def pauliPointVariableCondition (P : AdmissibleParams) (W : PauliKind)
   869	    (z : PauliSpace P) (j : Fin 9) (a : PauliScalar P) (β : ZMod 2) : Prop :=
   870	  pauliPairGamma P z = 0 ∨
   871	    (j = ⟨0, by decide⟩ ∧ W = .X ∧
   872	        fixedBinTrace P.model (a * pauliRXBlock z) = β) ∨
   873	    (j = ⟨4, by decide⟩ ∧ W = .Z ∧
   874	        fixedBinTrace P.model (a * pauliRZBlock z) = β)
   875	
   876	/-- The Pauli win predicate, with constructor-shape rejection.  This is
   877	`def:pauli-win-predicate` in `blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:331-367`,
   878	paper origin `references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1126-1225`.
   879	-/
   880	noncomputable def pauliWinPredicate (P : AdmissibleParams) :
   881	    PauliQuestion P → PauliQuestion P → PauliAnswer P → PauliAnswer P → Bool :=
   882	  open Classical in
   883	  fun (tA, xA) (tB, xB) a b =>
   884	    if validPauliAnswer tA a && validPauliAnswer tB b then
   885	      if tA = tB then
   886	        decide (a = b)
   887	      else
   888	        match tA, tB, a, b with
   889	      | .aline W, .point W', .alinePoly f, .value u =>
   890	          if W = W' then decide (pauliAlinePointCondition P W xA xB f u) else true
   891	      | .point W, .aline W', .value u, .alinePoly f =>
   892	          if W = W' then decide (pauliAlinePointCondition P W xB xA f u) else true
   893	      | .dline W, .point W', .dlinePoly f, .value u =>
   894	          if W = W' then decide (pauliDlinePointCondition P W xA xB f u) else true
   895	      | .point W, .dline W', .value u, .dlinePoly f =>
   896	          if W = W' then decide (pauliDlinePointCondition P W xB xA f u) else true
   897	      | .point W, .pauli W', .value u, .pauliOutcome h =>
   898	          if W = W' then decide (pauliPointPauliCondition P W xA h u) else true
   899	      | .pauli W, .point W', .pauliOutcome h, .value u =>
   900	          if W = W' then decide (pauliPointPauliCondition P W xB h u) else true

     4	/-!
     5	# Games, tensor-product strategies, and value
     6	
     7	This file provides the finite game carrier used by the Pauli basis test.  Pure
     8	states are vectors in `EuclideanSpace`, and POVMs use the project's matrix
     9	`Measurement` structure.
    10	
    11	## References
    12	
    13	The source-facing nodes are `def:game`, `def:povm-conventions`,
    14	`def:tensor-product-strategy`, and `def:tensor-product-value` in
    15	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch12_qpbt_games.tex:47-82` and `8-26`.
    16	The paper origin is `references/qpbt-paper/06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:10-57`.
    17	-/
    18	
    19	open scoped BigOperators Matrix ComplexOrder
    20	
    21	namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
    22	
    23	open MIPStarRE.LDT
    24	open MIPStarRE.Quantum
    25	
    26	/--
    27	A finite two-player one-round game with a probability distribution on question
    28	pairs and a Boolean decision predicate.  This is `def:game` in
    29	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch12_qpbt_games.tex:51-59`, with paper origin
    30	`references/qpbt-paper/06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:10-24`.
    31	-/
    32	structure Game where
    33	  QuestionA : Type
    34	  QuestionB : Type
    35	  AnswerA : Type
    36	  AnswerB : Type
    37	  [questionAFintype : Fintype QuestionA]
    38	  [questionBFintype : Fintype QuestionB]
    39	  [answerAFintype : Fintype AnswerA]
    40	  [answerBFintype : Fintype AnswerB]
    41	  [questionADecidableEq : DecidableEq QuestionA]
    42	  [questionBDecidableEq : DecidableEq QuestionB]
    43	  [answerADecidableEq : DecidableEq AnswerA]
    44	  [answerBDecidableEq : DecidableEq AnswerB]
    45	  μ : Distribution (QuestionA × QuestionB)
    46	  μ_prob : μ.IsProbability
    47	  decide : QuestionA → QuestionB → AnswerA → AnswerB → Bool
    48	
    49	attribute [instance] Game.questionAFintype Game.questionBFintype
    50	  Game.answerAFintype Game.answerBFintype Game.questionADecidableEq
    51	  Game.questionBDecidableEq Game.answerADecidableEq Game.answerBDecidableEq
    52	
    53	/--
    54	The marginal of a joint POVM obtained by post-processing its answer pair.  This
    55	is the POVM convention of `def:povm-conventions` in
    56	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch12_qpbt_games.tex:8-26`; the post-processing operation
    57	is the already formalized `Measurement.postprocess`, with paper origin
    58	`references/qpbt-paper/06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:26-38`.
    59	-/
    60	noncomputable def marginalLeft {α β d : Type*}
    61	    [Fintype α] [Fintype β] [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β]
    62	    [Fintype d] [DecidableEq d]
    63	    (M : Measurement (α × β) d) : Measurement α d :=
    64	  M.postprocess Prod.fst
    65	
    66	/-- The right marginal of a joint POVM, obtained using `Prod.snd` in
    67	`def:povm-conventions`, `blueprint/src/chapter/ch12_qpbt_games.tex:8-26`,
    68	paper origin `references/qpbt-paper/06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:26-38`.
    69	-/
    70	noncomputable def marginalRight {α β d : Type*}
    71	    [Fintype α] [Fintype β] [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β]
    72	    [Fintype d] [DecidableEq d]
    73	    (M : Measurement (α × β) d) : Measurement β d :=
    74	  M.postprocess Prod.snd
    75	
    76	/-- Projectivity of every effect in a POVM (`def:povm-conventions`, blueprint
    77	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch12_qpbt_games.tex:8-26`; paper origin
    78	`references/qpbt-paper/06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:68-72`). -/
    79	def Measurement.IsProjective {α d : Type*} [Fintype α] [Fintype d] [DecidableEq d]
    80	    (M : Measurement α d) : Prop :=
    81	  ∀ a, IsProj (M.effect a)
    82	
    83	/--
    84	The tensor-product strategy of `def:tensor-product-strategy` in
    85	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch12_qpbt_games.tex:61-69` (paper origin
    86	`references/qpbt-paper/06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:26-38`).
    87	-/
    88	structure Strategy (G : Game) where
    89	  ιA : Type
    90	  ιB : Type
    91	  [ιAFintype : Fintype ιA]
    92	  [ιBFintype : Fintype ιB]
    93	  [ιADecidableEq : DecidableEq ιA]
    94	  [ιBDecidableEq : DecidableEq ιB]
    95	  ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB)
    96	  ψ_norm : ‖ψ‖ = 1
    97	  A : G.QuestionA → Measurement G.AnswerA ιA
    98	  B : G.QuestionB → Measurement G.AnswerB ιB
    99	
   100	attribute [instance] Strategy.ιAFintype Strategy.ιBFintype
   101	  Strategy.ιADecidableEq Strategy.ιBDecidableEq
   102	
   103	/-- The rectangular tensor placement used in strategy probabilities.  This is
   104	the finite-matrix realization of `def:tensor-product-strategy`, blueprint
   105	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch12_qpbt_games.tex:61-69`; paper origin
   106	`references/qpbt-paper/06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:26-38`.
   107	-/
   108	def heteroKron {ιA ιB : Type*} (A : Op ιA) (B : Op ιB) : Op (ιA × ιB) :=
   109	  Matrix.kronecker A B
   110	
   111	/- The Euclidean linear map is the shared action used by the value and distance
   112	functionals.  Keeping it at the Euclidean-space level avoids accidentally
   113	using the function-space supremum norm of `Matrix.mulVec`. -/
   114	/-- Apply a finite matrix to a Euclidean-space state.  This is the Hilbert-space
   115	action underlying `def:tensor-product-value`, paper
   116	`references/qpbt-paper/06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:219-271`. -/
   117	noncomputable def applyOperatorToState {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   118	    (M : Op ι) (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι :=
   119	  Matrix.toEuclideanLin M ψ
   120	
   121	/-- The Born weight of an answer pair for a strategy.  Lean-only support for
   122	`def:tensor-product-value`, blueprint `ch12_qpbt_games.tex:71-82`, paper
   123	`references/qpbt-paper/06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:40-48`. -/
   124	noncomputable def outcomeWeight {G : Game} (S : Strategy G)
   125	    (x : G.QuestionA) (y : G.QuestionB) (a : G.AnswerA) (b : G.AnswerB) : ℝ :=
   126	  let M : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (S.ιA × S.ιB) :=
   127	    heteroKron ((S.A x).effect a) ((S.B y).effect b)
   128	  let acted := applyOperatorToState M S.ψ
   129	  (inner ℂ S.ψ acted).re
   130	
   131	/-- Every answer-pair Born weight is nonnegative.  This is formalization-only
   132	support for the probability expression in `def:tensor-product-value`. -/
   133	theorem outcomeWeight_nonneg {G : Game} (S : Strategy G)
   134	    (x : G.QuestionA) (y : G.QuestionB) (a : G.AnswerA) (b : G.AnswerB) :
   135	    0 ≤ outcomeWeight S x y a b := by
   136	  unfold outcomeWeight applyOperatorToState heteroKron
   137	  exact
   138	    (Matrix.isPositive_toEuclideanLin_iff.mpr
   139	      (Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mp
   140	        (kronecker_nonneg ((S.A x).pos a) ((S.B y).pos b)))).re_inner_nonneg_right S.ψ
   141	
   142	/-- The Born weights of all answer pairs at fixed questions sum to one.  This
   143	is formalization-only support for the POVM normalization implicit in
   144	`def:tensor-product-value`. -/
   145	theorem outcomeWeight_sum_eq_one {G : Game} (S : Strategy G)
   146	    (x : G.QuestionA) (y : G.QuestionB) :
   147	    ∑ a : G.AnswerA, ∑ b : G.AnswerB, outcomeWeight S x y a b = 1 := by
   148	  have hsum :
   149	      (∑ a : G.AnswerA, ∑ b : G.AnswerB,
   150	        heteroKron ((S.A x).effect a) ((S.B y).effect b)) =
   151	          (1 : Op (S.ιA × S.ιB)) := by
   152	    ext i j
   153	    simp only [Matrix.sum_apply, heteroKron, Matrix.kronecker,
   154	      Matrix.kroneckerMap_apply]
   155	    simp_rw [← Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_mul]
   156	    rw [show (∑ a : G.AnswerA, (S.A x).effect a i.1 j.1) =
   157	        (1 : Op S.ιA) i.1 j.1 by
   158	      simpa only [Matrix.sum_apply] using congrFun (congrFun (S.A x).sum_eq_one i.1) j.1]
   159	    rw [show (∑ b : G.AnswerB, (S.B y).effect b i.2 j.2) =
   160	        (1 : Op S.ιB) i.2 j.2 by
   161	      simpa only [Matrix.sum_apply] using congrFun (congrFun (S.B y).sum_eq_one i.2) j.2]
   162	    exact congrFun (congrFun
   163	      (Matrix.one_kronecker_one (m := S.ιA) (n := S.ιB) (α := ℂ)) i) j
   164	  calc
   165	    ∑ a : G.AnswerA, ∑ b : G.AnswerB, outcomeWeight S x y a b =
   166	        (inner ℂ S.ψ
   167	          (applyOperatorToState
   168	            (∑ a : G.AnswerA, ∑ b : G.AnswerB,
   169	              heteroKron ((S.A x).effect a) ((S.B y).effect b)) S.ψ)).re := by
   170	          simp [outcomeWeight, applyOperatorToState]
   171	    _ = (inner ℂ S.ψ (applyOperatorToState 1 S.ψ)).re := by rw [hsum]
   172	    _ = 1 := by
   173	      simp [applyOperatorToState, S.ψ_norm]
   174	
   175	/--
   176	The tensor-product value, expressed as the distribution average of the Born
   177	probabilities.  This is `def:tensor-product-value` in
   178	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch12_qpbt_games.tex:71-82`, with paper origin
   179	`references/qpbt-paper/06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:40-57`.
   180	-/
   181	noncomputable def Strategy.value {G : Game} (S : Strategy G) : ℝ :=
   182	  avgOver G.μ (fun xy =>
   183	    ∑ a : G.AnswerA, ∑ b : G.AnswerB,
   184	      if G.decide xy.1 xy.2 a b then outcomeWeight S xy.1 xy.2 a b else 0)
   185	
   186	/--
   187	The tensor-product game value as a conditional supremum over all finite
   188	strategies.  The `sSup (Set.range ...)` form is the csSup formulation requested
   189	for `def:tensor-product-value`, blueprint
   190	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch12_qpbt_games.tex:71-82`, paper origin
   191	`references/qpbt-paper/06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:40-57`; attainment is
   192	intentionally not asserted here.
   193	-/
   194	noncomputable def Game.value (G : Game) : ℝ :=
   195	  sSup (Set.range (fun S : Strategy G => S.value))
   196	
   197	end MIPStarRE.QPBT

     6	/-!
     7	# The Pauli basis test
     8	
     9	This file supplies the finite question and answer alphabets, the typed
    10	conditionally-linear question sampler, and the Boolean win predicate for the
    11	Pauli basis test.  The quantitative soundness theorem is isolated in
    12	`Soundness.lean`.
    13	
    14	## References
    15	
    16	The source-facing nodes are `def:admissible`, `def:pauli-question-distribution`,
    17	and `def:pauli-win-predicate` in
    18	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:269-367`; their paper origin is
    19	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:908-1225`.
    20	-/
    21	
    22	open scoped BigOperators
    23	
    24	namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
    25	
    26	open MIPStarRE.LDT
    27	
    28	noncomputable section
    29	
    30	/-- The numerical admissible Pauli-test parameter package.  Its scalar carrier
    31	uses the once-and-for-all model `fixedFieldModel q hq`, so the paper's fixed
    32	self-dual-normal identification is not quantified in the test statement.  This
    33	is `def:admissible` in
    34	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:269-283`, paper origin
    35	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:958-961`.
    36	-/
    37	structure AdmissibleParams where
    38	  q : ℕ
    39	  m : ℕ
    40	  d : ℕ
    41	  hd : 1 ≤ d
    42	  hq : IsAdmissibleSize q
    43	  hdvd : m ∣ q
    44	
    45	/-- The positivity of the ambient dimension is a proof obligation implicit in
    46	the admissibility convention `def:admissible`, blueprint
    47	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:269-283`, paper origin
    48	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:958-961`.
    49	-/
    50	theorem AdmissibleParams.one_le_m (P : AdmissibleParams) : 1 ≤ P.m := by
    51	  obtain ⟨k, -, hk⟩ := P.hq
    52	  have hq : 0 < P.q := by
    53	    rw [hk]
    54	    positivity
    55	  exact Nat.pos_of_dvd_of_pos P.hdvd hq
    56	
    57	/-- The fixed model accessor for an admissible parameter package.  It is a
    58	compatibility view of the global `fixedFieldModel` selector, not an independently
    59	quantified field representation.  Blueprint `ch13_qpbt_test.tex:269-283`; paper
    60	origin `references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:958-961`.
    61	-/
    62	noncomputable def AdmissibleParams.model (P : AdmissibleParams) : FixedFieldModel P.q :=
    63	  fixedFieldModel P.q P.hq
    64	
    65	/-- The low-degree parameter view of an admissible Pauli-test package.  This is
    66	a Lean-only bridge supporting the statement closure; it is not an additional
    67	hypothesis of `thm:pauli`.  Blueprint
    68	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:17-31`, paper origin
    69	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:958-961`.
    70	-/
    71	def AdmissibleParams.toLdParams (P : AdmissibleParams) : LdParams where
    72	  q := P.q
    73	  m := P.m
    74	  d := P.d
    75	  k := 1
    76	  hm := P.one_le_m
    77	  hd := P.hd
    78	  hk := by decide
    79	  hq := P.hq
    80	  hdvd := P.hdvd
    81	
    82	/-- The scalar carrier associated with an admissible parameter package.  It is
    83	the globally fixed field carrier selected by `AdmissibleParams.model` in
    84	`def:admissible`, blueprint

   267	  funext x
   268	  have hx : coordinateRestriction (Finset.univ : Finset ι) x = x := by
   269	    funext i
   270	    simp [coordinateRestriction]
   271	  show L (coordinateRestriction Finset.univ x) + 0 = L x

   274	/-- Formalization-only auxiliary: extend a coefficient vector along an injective
   275	reindexing of registers, setting every coordinate outside the image to zero.
   276	Together with the lemmas that follow it, this supports the transport of
   277	conditional linearity between the register spaces of `def:cl-func`,
   278	blueprint `blueprint/src/chapter/ch12_qpbt_games.tex:453-463`,
   279	paper origin `references/qpbt-paper/05_conditionally_linear_functions.tex:35-57`. -/

   281	  Function.extend f u 0

   283	/-- Formalization-only auxiliary: the extension recovers the original
   284	coordinates along an injective reindexing. -/
   285	private theorem clExtend_apply {K κ ι : Type*} [Zero K] {f : κ → ι}
   286	    (hf : Function.Injective f) (u : κ → K) (k : κ) :
   287	    clExtend f u (f k) = u k :=
   288	  hf.extend_apply u 0 k
   289	
   290	/-- Formalization-only auxiliary: the extension vanishes at any coordinate
   291	outside the image of the reindexing. -/
   292	private theorem clExtend_eq_zero_of_not_mem {K κ ι : Type*} [Zero K]
   293	    (f : κ → ι) (u : κ → K) (i : ι) (h : ∀ k, f k ≠ i) :
   294	    clExtend f u i = 0 :=
   295	  Function.extend_apply' u (0 : ι → K) i
   296	    (fun hex => h hex.choose hex.choose_spec)
   297	
   298	/-- Formalization-only auxiliary: restriction along an injective reindexing
   299	inverts the extension. -/
   300	private theorem clExtend_comp {K κ ι : Type*} [Zero K] {f : κ → ι}
   301	    (hf : Function.Injective f) (u : κ → K) :
   302	    (fun k => clExtend f u (f k)) = u :=
   303	  funext fun k => clExtend_apply hf u k

   305	/-- Formalization-only auxiliary: the extension of the zero vector vanishes. -/
   306	private theorem clExtend_zero {K κ ι : Type*} [Zero K] {f : κ → ι}
   307	    (hf : Function.Injective f) : clExtend f (0 : κ → K) = 0 := by
   308	  funext i
   309	  by_cases h : ∃ k, f k = i
   310	  · obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := h
   311	    simp [clExtend_apply hf]
   312	  · simp [clExtend, Function.extend_apply' _ _ _ h]
   313	
   314	/-- Formalization-only auxiliary: the extension is additive. -/
   315	private theorem clExtend_add {K κ ι : Type*} [AddZeroClass K] {f : κ → ι}
   316	    (hf : Function.Injective f) (u v : κ → K) :
   317	    clExtend f (u + v) = clExtend f u + clExtend f v := by
   318	  funext i
   319	  by_cases h : ∃ k, f k = i
   320	  · obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := h
   321	    simp [clExtend_apply hf]
   322	  · simp [clExtend, Function.extend_apply' _ _ _ h]
   323	
   324	/-- Formalization-only auxiliary: the extension commutes with scalars. -/
   325	private theorem clExtend_smul {K κ ι : Type*} [Semiring K] {f : κ → ι}
   326	    (hf : Function.Injective f) (c : K) (u : κ → K) :
   327	    clExtend f (c • u) = c • clExtend f u := by
   328	  funext i
   329	  by_cases h : ∃ k, f k = i
   330	  · obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := h
   331	    simp [clExtend_apply hf]
   332	  · simp [clExtend, Function.extend_apply' _ _ _ h]

   334	/-- Formalization-only auxiliary: transport a linear map of coefficient vectors
   335	along an injective reindexing of registers; see `clExtend`.  Supports
   336	`def:cl-func`, blueprint `blueprint/src/chapter/ch12_qpbt_games.tex:453-463`,
   337	paper origin `references/qpbt-paper/05_conditionally_linear_functions.tex:35-57`. -/
   338	private def clReindexLinear {K κ ι : Type*} [Field K] {f : κ → ι}
   339	    (hf : Function.Injective f) (L : (κ → K) →ₗ[K] (κ → K)) :
   340	    (ι → K) →ₗ[K] (ι → K) where
   341	  toFun x := clExtend f (L (fun k => x (f k)))
   342	  map_add' x y := by
   343	    show clExtend f (L (fun k => (x + y) (f k))) =
   344	      clExtend f (L (fun k => x (f k))) + clExtend f (L (fun k => y (f k)))
   345	    have h : (fun k => (x + y) (f k)) =
   346	        (fun k => x (f k)) + (fun k => y (f k)) := rfl
   347	    rw [h, map_add, clExtend_add hf]
   348	  map_smul' c x := by
   349	    show clExtend f (L (fun k => (c • x) (f k))) =
   350	      c • clExtend f (L (fun k => x (f k)))
   351	    have h : (fun k => (c • x) (f k)) = c • (fun k => x (f k)) := rfl
   352	    rw [h, map_smul, clExtend_smul hf]

   354	/-- Formalization-only auxiliary: transport a conditionally linear syntax tree
   355	along an injective reindexing of registers; see `clExtend`.  Supports
   356	`def:cl-func`, blueprint `blueprint/src/chapter/ch12_qpbt_games.tex:453-463`,
   357	paper origin `references/qpbt-paper/05_conditionally_linear_functions.tex:35-57`. -/
   358	private def clReindexTerm {K κ ι : Type*} [Field K] [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ]
   359	    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {f : κ → ι} (hf : Function.Injective f) :
   360	    {ell : ℕ} → CondLinearTerm K (ι := κ) ell → CondLinearTerm K (ι := ι) ell
   361	  | _, .zero => .zero
   362	  | _, .succ S₁ L₁ h rest =>
   363	      .succ (S₁.image f) (clReindexLinear hf L₁)
   364	        (by
   365	          intro x i hi
   366	          by_cases hex : ∃ k, f k = i
   367	          · obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := hex
   368	            have hk : k ∉ S₁ := fun hk => hi (Finset.mem_image_of_mem f hk)
   369	            show clExtend f (L₁ (fun j => x (f j))) (f k) = 0
   370	            rw [clExtend_apply hf]
   371	            exact h _ k hk
   372	          · show clExtend f (L₁ (fun j => x (f j))) i = 0
   373	            simp [clExtend, Function.extend_apply' _ _ _ hex])
   374	        (fun y => clReindexTerm hf (rest (fun k => y (f k))))

   376	/-- Formalization-only auxiliary: the transported syntax tree is supported on
   377	any register containing the image of the original support. -/
   378	private theorem clReindexTerm_supportedOn {K κ ι : Type*} [Field K]
   379	    [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {f : κ → ι}
   380	    (hf : Function.Injective f) :
   381	    ∀ {ell : ℕ} (t : CondLinearTerm K (ι := κ) ell) (S : Finset κ)
   382	      (T : Finset ι), t.supportedOn S → S.image f ⊆ T →
   383	      (clReindexTerm hf t).supportedOn T := by
   384	  intro ell t
   385	  induction t with
   386	  | zero => intro S T _ _; trivial
   387	  | succ S₁ L₁ hL rest ih =>
   388	      intro S T hsupp hST
   389	      obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hsupp
   390	      refine ⟨fun i hi => hST (Finset.image_subset_image h1 hi), fun y => ?_⟩
   391	      refine ih (fun k => y (f k)) (S \ S₁) (T \ S₁.image f) (h2 _) ?_
   392	      intro i hi
   393	      obtain ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hi
   394	      obtain ⟨hkS, hkS₁⟩ := Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hk
   395	      refine Finset.mem_sdiff.mpr ⟨hST (Finset.mem_image_of_mem f hkS), ?_⟩
   396	      intro hmem
   397	      obtain ⟨k', hk', hk'eq⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hmem
   398	      exact hkS₁ (hf hk'eq ▸ hk')

   400	/-- Formalization-only auxiliary: evaluation commutes with the transport of a
   401	conditionally linear syntax tree along an injective reindexing. -/
   402	private theorem clReindexTerm_eval {K κ ι : Type*} [Field K]
   403	    [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {f : κ → ι}
   404	    (hf : Function.Injective f) :
   405	    ∀ {ell : ℕ} (t : CondLinearTerm K (ι := κ) ell) (x : ι → K),
   406	      CondLinearTerm.eval (clReindexTerm hf t) x =
   407	        clExtend f (CondLinearTerm.eval t (fun k => x (f k))) := by
   408	  intro ell t
   409	  induction t with
   410	  | zero => intro x; exact (clExtend_zero hf).symm
   411	  | succ S₁ L₁ hL rest ih =>
   412	      intro x
   413	      have hres : (fun k => coordinateRestriction (S₁.image f) x (f k)) =
   414	          coordinateRestriction S₁ (fun k => x (f k)) := by
   415	        funext k
   416	        by_cases hk : k ∈ S₁
   417	        · have hmem : f k ∈ S₁.image f := Finset.mem_image_of_mem f hk
   418	          simp [coordinateRestriction, hk, hmem]
   419	        · have hni : f k ∉ S₁.image f := by
   420	            intro hmem
   421	            obtain ⟨k', hk', hk'eq⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hmem
   422	            exact hk (hf hk'eq ▸ hk')
   423	          simp [coordinateRestriction, hk, hni]
   424	      have hhead : clReindexLinear hf L₁ (coordinateRestriction (S₁.image f) x) =
   425	          clExtend f (L₁ (coordinateRestriction S₁ (fun k => x (f k)))) := by
   426	        show clExtend f (L₁ (fun k => coordinateRestriction (S₁.image f) x (f k))) = _
   427	        rw [hres]
   428	      have hcomp : (fun k => clReindexLinear hf L₁
   429	            (coordinateRestriction (S₁.image f) x) (f k)) =
   430	          L₁ (coordinateRestriction S₁ (fun k => x (f k))) := by
   431	        rw [hhead]
   432	        exact clExtend_comp hf _
   433	      show clReindexLinear hf L₁ (coordinateRestriction (S₁.image f) x) +
   434	          CondLinearTerm.eval (clReindexTerm hf (rest
   435	            (fun k => clReindexLinear hf L₁
   436	              (coordinateRestriction (S₁.image f) x) (f k)))) x =
   437	        clExtend f (L₁ (coordinateRestriction S₁ (fun k => x (f k))) +
   438	          CondLinearTerm.eval
   439	            (rest (L₁ (coordinateRestriction S₁ (fun k => x (f k)))))
   440	            (fun k => x (f k)))
   441	      rw [hcomp, ih _ x, hhead, ← clExtend_add hf]

   446	private theorem isCondLinearOn_reindex {K κ ι : Type*} [Field K]
   447	    [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {f : κ → ι}

   451	      (fun x => clExtend f (L (fun k => x (f k)))) := by
   452	  obtain ⟨t, hsupp, hval⟩ := h
   453	  refine ⟨clReindexTerm hf t,
   454	    clReindexTerm_supportedOn hf t Finset.univ Finset.univ hsupp
   455	      (Finset.subset_univ _), ?_⟩
   456	  funext x

    22	/-- A finite-support weighted distribution with nonnegative real-valued weights. -/
    23	structure Distribution (α : Type*) where
    24	  support : Finset α := ∅
    25	  weight : α → Error := fun _ => 0
    26	  nonnegative : ∀ a, 0 ≤ weight a := by intro _; positivity
    27	  outsideSupport : ∀ a, a ∉ support → weight a = 0 := by intro _ _; rfl

    31	/-- The total mass carried by the explicit support of a distribution. -/
    32	def totalWeight {α : Type*} (𝒟 : Distribution α) : Error :=
    33	  ∑ a ∈ 𝒟.support, 𝒟.weight a
    34	
    35	/-- A `Distribution` is probabilistic when its total mass is exactly `1`. -/

    39	/-- Push a finite-support distribution forward along a map.

    42	image of the original finite support, and each new weight is the sum of the
    43	weights in the corresponding fiber. -/

    45	    (𝒟 : Distribution α) (e : α → β) : Distribution β where
    46	  support := 𝒟.support.image e
    47	  weight := fun b => ∑ a ∈ 𝒟.support.filter (fun a => e a = b), 𝒟.weight a
    48	  nonnegative := fun _ => Finset.sum_nonneg fun a _ => 𝒟.nonnegative a
    49	  outsideSupport := fun _ hb =>
    50	    Finset.sum_eq_zero fun a ha =>
    51	      (hb (Finset.mem_image.mpr
    52	        ⟨a, (Finset.mem_filter.mp ha).1, (Finset.mem_filter.mp ha).2⟩)).elim

    56	    (𝒟 : Distribution α) (e : α → β) :
    57	    (𝒟.map e).support = 𝒟.support.image e := rfl
    58	
    59	@[simp]

    61	    (𝒟 : Distribution α) (e : α → β) (b : β) :
    62	    (𝒟.map e).weight b =
    63	      ∑ a ∈ 𝒟.support.filter (fun a => e a = b), 𝒟.weight a := rfl

    71	      (s := 𝒟.support) (t := 𝒟.support.image e) (g := e)

   164	/-- The Mathlib probability mass function associated to a project `Distribution`

   196	    (h𝒟 : 𝒟.IsProbability) {a : α} (ha : a ∉ 𝒟.support) :
   197	    𝒟.toPMF h𝒟 a = 0 := by

   201	/-- The project push-forward agrees with Mathlib's push-forward of the
   202	associated probability mass function. -/
   203	theorem toPMF_map {α β : Type*} [DecidableEq β]
   204	    (𝒟 : Distribution α) (h𝒟 : 𝒟.IsProbability) (e : α → β) :
   205	    (𝒟.map e).toPMF (h𝒟.map e) = (𝒟.toPMF h𝒟).map e := by
   206	  classical
   207	  ext b
   208	  rw [toPMF_apply, PMF.map_apply, map_weight]
   209	  rw [ENNReal.ofReal_sum_of_nonneg
   210	    (s := 𝒟.support.filter (fun a => e a = b))
   211	    (fun a _ => 𝒟.nonnegative a)]
   212	  rw [tsum_eq_sum (s := 𝒟.support)]
   213	  · rw [Finset.sum_filter]
   214	    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
   215	    intro a ha
   216	    by_cases hea : e a = b
   217	    · have hba : b = e a := hea.symm
   218	      rw [if_pos hea, if_pos hba, toPMF_apply]
   219	    · have hba : b ≠ e a := fun hba => hea hba.symm
   220	      rw [if_neg hea, if_neg hba]
   221	  · intro a ha
   222	    by_cases hba : b = e a
   223	    · rw [if_pos hba, toPMF_apply_of_notMem 𝒟 h𝒟 ha]
   224	    · rw [if_neg hba]

/-- Average a scalar function against the stored finite support of a distribution. -/
def avgOver {α : Type*} (𝒟 : Distribution α) (f : α → Error) : Error :=
  ∑ a ∈ 𝒟.support, 𝒟.weight a * f a

namespace Distribution

/-- The module-valued weighted finite sum associated to a finite-support `Distribution`,
as a linear map in the averaged family.

This packages the finite-support expression underlying both scalar averages and
operator averages.  It keeps the explicit support carried by `Distribution`,
while exposing the `Error`-module structure of the weighted sum. -/
noncomputable def weightedSumLinearMap (M : Type*) [AddCommMonoid M] [Module Error M]
    {α : Type*} (𝒟 : Distribution α) : (α → M) →ₗ[Error] M where
  toFun := fun f => ∑ a ∈ 𝒟.support, 𝒟.weight a • f a
  map_add' := fun f g => by
    simp only [Pi.add_apply, smul_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  map_smul' := fun c f => by
    simp only [Pi.smul_apply]
    calc
      ∑ a ∈ 𝒟.support, 𝒟.weight a • c • f a =
          ∑ a ∈ 𝒟.support, c • (𝒟.weight a • f a) := by
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
            intro a _
            rw [smul_smul, smul_smul, mul_comm]
      _ = c • ∑ a ∈ 𝒟.support, 𝒟.weight a • f a := by
            rw [Finset.smul_sum]

@[simp]
theorem weightedSumLinearMap_apply (M : Type*) [AddCommMonoid M] [Module Error M]
    {α : Type*} (𝒟 : Distribution α) (f : α → M) :
    𝒟.weightedSumLinearMap M f = ∑ a ∈ 𝒟.support, 𝒟.weight a • f a :=
  rfl

/-- The scalar average is the weighted finite-sum linear map applied to a scalar
family. -/
theorem avgOver_eq_weightedSumLinearMap {α : Type*}
    (𝒟 : Distribution α) (f : α → Error) :
    avgOver 𝒟 f = 𝒟.weightedSumLinearMap Error f := by
  simp [avgOver, smul_eq_mul]

/-- Averaging against a pushed-forward distribution is averaging the pulled-back
function against the original distribution. -/
theorem avgOver_map {α β : Type*} [DecidableEq β]
    (𝒟 : Distribution α) (e : α → β) (f : β → Error) :
    avgOver (𝒟.map e) f = avgOver 𝒟 (fun a => f (e a)) := by
  simpa [avgOver, smul_eq_mul] using
    Distribution.map_sum_smul (𝒟 := 𝒟) e f

end Distribution

/-- Weighted sum of operators over a distribution's finite support, using the same
`support`/`weight` data as the scalar `avgOver`.

This is a project-local adapter around Mathlib finite sums for the LDT
`Distribution` representation and `Quantum.Op` scalar action, not a replacement for
Mathlib's probability theory APIs. -/
noncomputable def averageOperatorOverDistribution {α : Type*}
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (𝒟 : Distribution α) (f : α → MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op ι) : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op ι :=
  ∑ a ∈ 𝒟.support, 𝒟.weight a • f a

namespace Distribution

/-- Operator averaging is the weighted finite-sum linear map applied to an
operator-valued family. -/
theorem averageOperatorOverDistribution_eq_weightedSumLinearMap {α : Type*}
    (𝒟 : Distribution α)
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (f : α → MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op ι) :
    averageOperatorOverDistribution 𝒟 f =
      𝒟.weightedSumLinearMap (MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op ι) f :=
  rfl

/-- Operator-valued averaging against a pushed-forward distribution is
operator-valued averaging of the pulled-back family against the original
distribution. -/
theorem averageOperatorOverDistribution_map {α β : Type*} [DecidableEq β]
    (𝒟 : Distribution α) (e : α → β)
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (f : β → MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op ι) :
    averageOperatorOverDistribution (𝒟.map e) f =
      averageOperatorOverDistribution 𝒟 (fun a => f (e a)) := by
  simpa [averageOperatorOverDistribution] using
    Distribution.map_sum_smul (𝒟 := 𝒟) e f

end Distribution

/-- If two operator-valued families agree pointwise, their averages agree. -/
theorem averageOperatorOverDistribution_congr {α : Type*}
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (𝒟 : Distribution α) (A B : α → MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op ι)
    (h : ∀ a, A a = B a) :
    averageOperatorOverDistribution 𝒟 A = averageOperatorOverDistribution 𝒟 B := by
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => by rw [h a]

/-- Pull a finite outcome sum through an operator-valued average. -/
theorem averageOperatorOverDistribution_sum {α β : Type*} [Fintype β]
    (𝒟 : Distribution α)
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (f : α → β → MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op ι) :
    averageOperatorOverDistribution 𝒟 (fun a => ∑ b : β, f a b) =
      ∑ b : β, averageOperatorOverDistribution 𝒟 (fun a => f a b) := by
  rw [show (fun a => ∑ b : β, f a b) = ∑ b : β, fun a => f a b by
    ext a
    simp]
  simp [Distribution.averageOperatorOverDistribution_eq_weightedSumLinearMap]

/-- Pull a finite-set outcome sum through an operator-valued average. -/
theorem averageOperatorOverDistribution_finset_sum {α β : Type*}
    (𝒟 : Distribution α) (s : Finset β)
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (f : α → β → MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op ι) :
    averageOperatorOverDistribution 𝒟 (fun a => ∑ b ∈ s, f a b) =
      ∑ b ∈ s, averageOperatorOverDistribution 𝒟 (fun a => f a b) := by
  rw [show (fun a => ∑ b ∈ s, f a b) = ∑ b ∈ s, fun a => f a b by
    ext a
    simp]
  simp [Distribution.averageOperatorOverDistribution_eq_weightedSumLinearMap]

/-- Operator averages preserve positivity. -/
theorem averageOperatorOverDistribution_nonneg {α : Type*}
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (𝒟 : Distribution α) (f : α → MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op ι)
    (hf : ∀ a, 0 ≤ f a) :
    0 ≤ averageOperatorOverDistribution 𝒟 f := by
  unfold averageOperatorOverDistribution
  exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun a _ => smul_nonneg (𝒟.nonnegative a) (hf a)

/-- Operator averages preserve pointwise order. -/
theorem averageOperatorOverDistribution_mono {α : Type*}
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (𝒟 : Distribution α) (f g : α → MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op ι)
    (hfg : ∀ a, f a ≤ g a) :
    averageOperatorOverDistribution 𝒟 f ≤ averageOperatorOverDistribution 𝒟 g := by
  unfold averageOperatorOverDistribution
  exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun a _ =>
    smul_le_smul_of_nonneg_left (hfg a) (𝒟.nonnegative a)

/-- The average of a constant operator is the total mass times that operator. -/
theorem averageOperatorOverDistribution_const {α : Type*}
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (𝒟 : Distribution α) (A : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op ι) :
    averageOperatorOverDistribution 𝒟 (fun _ : α => A) =
      (∑ a ∈ 𝒟.support, 𝒟.weight a) • A := by
  unfold averageOperatorOverDistribution
  rw [Finset.sum_smul]

/-- The average of a constant operator over a probability distribution is that
operator. -/
theorem averageOperatorOverDistribution_const_of_isProbability {α : Type*}
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (𝒟 : Distribution α) (h𝒟 : 𝒟.IsProbability) (A : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op ι) :
    averageOperatorOverDistribution 𝒟 (fun _ : α => A) = A := by
  rw [averageOperatorOverDistribution_const, h𝒟.weight_sum_eq_one]
  simp

/-- An average of effects against a sub-probability distribution is again bounded
above by the identity operator. -/
theorem averageOperatorOverDistribution_le_one_of_weight_sum_le_one {α : Type*}
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (𝒟 : Distribution α) (f : α → MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op ι)
    (h𝒟 : ∑ a ∈ 𝒟.support, 𝒟.weight a ≤ 1)
    (hf : ∀ a, f a ≤ 1) :
    averageOperatorOverDistribution 𝒟 f ≤ 1 := by
  calc
    averageOperatorOverDistribution 𝒟 f
        ≤ averageOperatorOverDistribution 𝒟 (fun _ : α => 1) := by
          exact averageOperatorOverDistribution_mono 𝒟 f (fun _ : α => 1) hf
    _ = (∑ a ∈ 𝒟.support, 𝒟.weight a) • (1 : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op ι) := by
          exact averageOperatorOverDistribution_const 𝒟 1
    _ ≤ (1 : Error) • (1 : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op ι) := by
          exact smul_le_smul_of_nonneg_right h𝒟 zero_le_one
    _ = 1 := by simp

/-- An average of effects against a probability distribution is again bounded
above by the identity operator. -/
theorem averageOperatorOverDistribution_le_one_of_isProbability {α : Type*}
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (𝒟 : Distribution α) (h𝒟 : 𝒟.IsProbability)
    (f : α → MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op ι) (hf : ∀ a, f a ≤ 1) :
    averageOperatorOverDistribution 𝒟 f ≤ 1 :=
  averageOperatorOverDistribution_le_one_of_weight_sum_le_one 𝒟 f h𝒟.weight_sum_le_one hf
